visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: A Match Does Not Add One
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The longest common subsequence of AGGTAB and GXTXAYB is GTAB with length 4, but the program prints 0.

solution.explanation: When two letters match, the common subsequence grows by one letter. Without the + 1 the value just copies the diagonal, which starts at 0, so no matter how many letters match the length stays 0.
